requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions for Print and Scan
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features for print and scan workflows, including automated document classification, error correction, and workflow optimization.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB need for efficiency and ROI with minimal IT support, and differentiates Magellan from competitors with unique AI capabilities.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires robust processing hardware and software integration; may depend on SMB portal and telemetry features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are available out-of-box; users can complete common scanning/printing tasks with at least 20% less manual intervention compared to prior HP SMB solutions; user satisfaction >80% in pilot.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated web-based portal tailored for unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs to manage multiple printers, monitor usage, perform troubleshooting, and access support resources.
requirements.Rationale: Target customers lack dedicated IT; central, user-friendly management is critical for operational efficiency and reduces support burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with device firmware and telemetry systems; must support both PDL and non-PDL SKUs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports registration, monitoring, basic troubleshooting, and reporting for all Magellan printers in a customer’s fleet; usability score >80% in user testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO in Segment
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for SMB color printing, including consumables, maintenance, and energy efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: TCO is a top decision factor for SMBs and a key differentiator against competitors like Epson and Canon.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires use of high-capacity ink tanks, optimized energy consumption, and minimal scheduled maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis confirms Magellan’s TCO is at least 10% lower than leading competitor models in target geographies.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that end-users (not just technicians) can easily swap, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack IT staff and require minimal-intervention solutions; this is a new feature for HP in this segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Design must ensure ease-of-access and minimal risk of incorrect installation; may impact warranty/service processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box replacement can be completed by a non-technical user in <5 minutes with no tools; instructional material provided.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and reduce user error, supporting both environmental and operational goals.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents costly errors for SMBs and supports sustainability and serviceability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatible tank and bottle design; must be supported by supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles cannot be inserted into the wrong tank; error rate <1% in field trials.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 pages printed or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Meets SMB expectations for reliability and supports value proposition.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires reliability engineering and warranty process updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published and honored; field failure rate within agreed thresholds for covered period.

requirements.Title: PHA and MINK Serviceability Model
requirements.Description: Implement a service model where PHA parts are customer-replaceable and MINK parts are serviced at centers, with a target to maximize customer-replaceable components.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and cost for SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires clear documentation and design for user accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 80% of common field-replaceable parts are customer-replaceable; service documentation available.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Enable Magellan to support HP’s PaaS offerings, including remote management, usage-based billing, and integration with HP’s cloud services.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic goal of accelerating PaaS adoption and recurring revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP cloud and billing systems; must meet security and privacy standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan can be enrolled in HP PaaS and managed remotely; meets HP’s PaaS compliance checklist.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Enhanced Print Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: PDL SKUs must deliver print speeds of at least 25/20 ppm (improvement over current 25/19) and support PDL/PS (Page Description Languages/PostScript).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of more demanding SMBs and competitive parity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware capable of higher speeds and appropriate firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in standard test conditions; passes compatibility testing with major PDL/PS workflows.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure PDL SKU meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental compliance is increasingly a purchase criterion for SMBs and required in some regions.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design to meet power, emissions, and material standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and provides competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain and materials sourcing must support high RCP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials confirms 60% RCP; verified by third-party audit.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable robust mobile printing capabilities through the HP App, supporting iOS and Android platforms.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexibility and mobile workflows; aligns with customer use cases.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires app integration and firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices with <2 steps; passes compatibility testing with major mobile OS versions.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry for Fleet Management
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry for monitoring device health, usage, and predictive maintenance, accessible via the SMB portal and for HP support teams.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, reduces downtime, and supports PaaS and managed print services.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure data transmission and integration with HP backend systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is updated in real-time, actionable insights provided to users and HP support; meets HP security standards.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate ‘Perfect Print’ and ‘Perfect Scan’ solutions leveraging AI for optimal print quality and automated scan enhancements.
requirements.Rationale: Key differentiator for Magellan; directly addresses SMB needs for quality and productivity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI solution integration and hardware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print and scan outputs meet or exceed predefined quality benchmarks in >95% of test cases.

requirements.Title: Support for Advanced View SMB Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKUs must support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for enhanced manageability and reporting.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures all product variants offer value-added management features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with Advanced View SMB portal at launch.
